Our Electrical Services

From one extra socket at home to the full lighting and power on a commercial unit.

Consumer Units

Old fuse boards replaced with a modern consumer unit, every circuit labelled so you know what each switch does.

EV Charge Points

Home charge points fitted on their own circuit, with a neat cable run and an isolator beside the charger.

Indoor and Outdoor Lighting

Ceiling, feature and wall lights inside and out, from a porch lantern to a full LED workshop ceiling.

Why Choose HG Electrical & Services

Good electrical work is the kind you never have to think about again. It is set out neatly, labelled clearly and explained before we leave.

  • Tested and Certificated

    The work is tested when it is finished and the certificate is yours, not a promise of it.

  • Clear, Free Quotes

    Send a few photos or book a visit and you get a clear price before any work starts.

  • Neat Is Not Cosmetic

    Cables run square and every circuit labelled, because that is what makes the next job quick and safe.

  • Homes and Businesses

    From a home charge point to the lighting and power in a commercial unit, handled by the same team.
